title: Storage viewer: every kind of file now opens, including video and audio
text: The in-CRM file viewer no longer says a file cannot be shown. Video and audio, such as Zoom recordings, play in the browser's own player straight from storage. Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OpenOffice, Apple files, text-like files, RTF, SVG and TIFF pictures, and zip contents open as a page. Saved HTML mockups open as the real page in a locked box with a View source toggle. Anything else gets a details page with its name, type, size and the readable text inside.
points: A file over 8 MB downloads straight from storage instead of through the CRM.
The Marketing documents viewer uses the same, and every document there has an Open button.
